value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task states 'Once you have found the key, the locked door must be open on the last step of the episode' — a rule that target_door_open must hold on the final step — but the candidate only has Existence(target_picked_up). This omits the door-open-on-last-step requirement and 'Open it, then pick up the ball' omits the ordering Precedence(target_door_open, target_picked_up). Note the candidate's Existence(target_picked_up) is correct as the goal ('pick up the ball' commands it). Add clauses capturing that target_door_open is required on the last step of the episode (keeping the task's stated condition on key_found); the ordering clause Precedence(target_door_open, target_picked_up) is also missing, though the environment constraint that target_picked_up cannot become true before target_door_open records that the task asked for it.
